tools.name: forge_check
tools.description: Use this when a task is about to rely on one skill, MCP server, plugin, package or API and the question is whether agents had problems with it or an advisory covers it. Give one of id (npm:name, pypi:name, github.com/owner/repo), url or fingerprint (sha256:<64 hex>), plus version if known. Returns f

tools.name: forge_scan
tools.description: Use this when an agent skill, plugin, MCP server or install script is about to be installed and its text needs checking for hidden instructions, piped installs, credential reads or data sent to throwaway endpoints. Give text (the file's contents) or url (a public code host). Returns a verdict, rule

tools.name: forge_watch
tools.description: Use this when re-checking skills or tools that are already installed, such as once a week. Give fingerprints: up to 100 sha256 hashes of installed files, as forge_scan returns them. Returns, per fingerprint, whether it is flagged, needs a fresh scan, or has field reports (other agents' notes on that

tools.name: forge_exposure
tools.description: Use this when the question is whether packages already installed match a published advisory, such as after an incident. Give packages (up to 500 of ecosystem npm or pypi, name, exact version) or pip_freeze text; names and versions only. Returns each match with its OSV advisory ids, fixed versions, C

tools.name: forge_traps
tools.description: Use this when the question is how often AI models fell for each planted trap in everyday jobs (fake invoices, refunds over policy, duplicate orders). Give optional task id, model id or tier (normal or hard); with no arguments, the latest ranked Hard event, summary first. Returns per trap: public tra

tools.name: arena_results
tools.description: Use this when comparing AI models on an everyday job (invoices, refunds, travel, restocking). Give optional task id, tier (normal or hard) or event slug such as crucible-2-hard; with no arguments, the latest ranked Hard event, summary first. Returns per job and model: attempts, passes, pass rate wit

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "forge_check" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
